newsitem.title: JAPAN: Meitec aims at 13.60 bln yen profit in 2001/02.
newsitem.headline: Meitec aims at 13.60 bln yen profit in 2001/02.

text.p: Japan's Meitec Corp, a software engineering service company, said on Tuesday it aimed to post a parent current profit of 13.60 billion yen in the year from April 1, 2001, up from its expected parent current profit of 5.00 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97.
In a new management plan announced on Tuesday, Meitec also said it aims to post a parent net profit of 6.10 billion yen on expected parent sales of 72.00 billion yen in 2001/02.
Maitec said it hopes to post a parent current profit of 8.50 billion yen and a net profit of 3.60 billion yen on sales of 53.00 billion yen in 1998/99.
The company expected a 1996/97 parent net profit of 2.20 billion yen on sales of 39.00 billion yen.
